synth.notes:
Ring A1/A2 moves y-/+6 with the beam. It carries blocks fully on the beam and pushes blocks it hits through a chain; the move is cancelled if a block would leave the colour-4 field.
Beam A4/A3 changes w by +-6. Blocks fully on the beam (any tag) move with the tip, and an extend also pushes the swept strip. If any block would leave the field or enter the ring, the beam changes alone. Step 87 is just this fully-on-beam case; no object field decides it.
Tags: the hooked next block with every other on-beam block collected becomes collected, and the first todo in legend x order becomes next. A collected block off the beam reverts to next. The legend centre 2x2 is 0 while collected.
HUD bar 3s = (n-1)//3, where n counts non-click actions. n is kept per returned frame so out-of-order steps resume the right count; fallback is 3*bar+1, or 0. Without this state it scores 49/70.
Unconfirmed: whether todo blocks can block or be dragged differently in layouts not seen here.
